name: RestoreAssist — trial sign-ups
job: Get Australian and New Zealand water-damage restoration tradies to start the free trial and generate their first inspection report.
audience: Australian water-damage restoration tradies — sole traders and small companies running insurer-facing reporting. Secondary: insurer claims teams and assessor networks.
offer: A free 15-day trial that produces real inspection reports, not a demo.
proof:
Free 15-day trial, 50 inspection report credits — reports run on your own Anthropic or OpenAI key, billed by them
Built for restoration work across Australia and New Zealand
avoid: we, our, us, my, i; leverage, synergy, unlock value, streamline, revolutionise, AI-powered, utilise, best-in-class, world-class, game-changer, revolutionary, seamless, powerful, unlock, journey, excited, thrilled, delighted; DocuSketch, Encircle, Magicplan, Xactimate; the abbreviation "RA"; any price; any rating or review count; App Store availability; NCC 2022; "S500 compliant" or "IICRC certified" (only "S500:2021-aligned" is defensible, and it is not approved); urgency — the tradie reading this already has it.
